---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: scenario
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:        "Scenario report"
  scen_name:    ""
  scen_desc:    ""
  image_file:   NULL
  logos:        NULL
  badges:       NULL
  status_df:    NULL
  runs_df:      NULL
  runs_plot:    NULL
  runs_note:    NULL
  run_info_df:  NULL
  size_df:      NULL
  verify_df:    NULL
  gen_plot:     NULL
  gen_day_plot: NULL
  cap_plot:     NULL
  newcap_plot:  NULL
  emis_df:      NULL
  cost_df:      NULL
  costs_plot:   NULL
  variants_df:  NULL
  levcost_df:   NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Shared helpers live in the package (see ?energyRt::report_helpers).
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
} else if (!is.null(params$image_file)) {
  emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
}
if (length(params$badges) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$badges,
                           frac_total = min(0.9, 0.08 * length(params$badges)),
                           output = fmt)
}
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$scen_desc))) params$scen_desc`

## Overview

```{r en-status, results='asis'}
tbl(params$status_df)
```

```{r en-size, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$size_df)}
tbl(params$size_df, caption = "Problem size")
```

```{r en-verify, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$verify_df)}
tbl(params$verify_df, caption = "Solution checks (verify_solution)")
```

```{r en-runs-header, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_df) && nrow(params$runs_df) > 0}
cat("## Runs\n")
```

```{r en-runs, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_df) && nrow(params$runs_df) > 0}
tbl(params$runs_df)
```

```{r en-runs-plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=2.5, eval=!is.null(params$runs_plot)}
params$runs_plot
```

```{r en-runs-note, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$runs_note)}
cat(params$runs_note, "\n")
```

```{r en-run-info, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$run_info_df)}
tbl(params$run_info_df, caption = "Reported run")
```
